انتهجنا (form VII)
# اِنْتَهَجْنَا (intahajnā) /in.ta.had͡ʒ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# اُنْتُهِجْنَا (untuhijnā) /un.tu.hid͡ʒ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
